core_obligations: Termwise input (proof lines 11765-11767): by the cited result from Modules on Sites, the pullback of a finite free O_D-module is a finite free O_C-module.
Preservation of summands (proof line 11767): the pullback functor f^* is additive, hence carries direct summands to direct summands.
Conclude (proof line 11768): each term of f^*F^bullet is therefore a direct summand of a finite free module, so f^*F^bullet is a strictly perfect complex of O_C-modules.
proof_roadmap: Recall that strict perfection is termwise: each term is a direct summand of a finite free module.
Use that pullback of finite free modules is finite free.
Use additivity of the pullback to preserve direct summands.
Conclude that the pulled back complex is again strictly perfect.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a morphism of ringed topoi pulls strictly perfect complexes back to strictly perfect complexes (statement lines 11754-11762). The proof is a termwise reduction: strict perfection is a termwise condition on direct summands of finite free modules, the cited result from Modules on Sites supplies finiteness of the pullback of a finite free module, and additivity of the pullback supplies preservation of direct summands (proof lines 11765-11768). The content is the recognition that both ingredients combine termwise. The claim is H2: one termwise reduction with two named inputs.
